name: High King
description: The ruler of the Realm of Eldraine whom Oko kidnapped and turned into a stag.

description_citations.text: "Oko". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko plots to eliminate the High King during the Grand Procession to destroy the peace between the elves and the Realm.
timeline.quote: he plotted to eliminate the High King himself

citation.text: "Oko", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko, in the form of Cado, joins the Grand Procession, bewitches the twins, has Garruk kill the guards and kidnaps the king.
timeline.quote: he kidnaps the man and flees into the wilds

citation.text: "Oko", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Oko turns the High King into a stag and puts it to sleep, planning to have the Wild Hunt find it.
timeline.quote: he had transformed the High King into a stag and had magically put it to sleep

citation.text: "Oko", section "The Wildered Quest". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
